title: On the forward self-similar solutions to the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations
summary: We establish the global existence of forward self-similar solutions to the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations for any divergence-free initial velocity that is homogeneous of degree $-1$ and locally Hölder continuous. This result requires no smallness assumption on the initial data.
